line: I told Claude Code the wrong bug. On purpose.
I said the loop skipped one entry — right at the top.
That's the kind of wrong instruction most AI tools just go along with.
This one didn't. It said the loop wasn't the bug at all.
The real bug was one line down — the math was right, then one got subtracted for no reason.
It fixed the actual problem. Not the one I described.
Claude Code comes with a normal Pro plan — twenty a month, nothing else to buy.
The exact setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
